subject: Fix build on 32-bit ARM by only using NEON on AArch64 (#2873)
reason: The change is a one-line build fix: it tightens the HAVE_ARM_NEON preprocessor guard in src/config.h to require __aarch64__, so NEON SIMD intrinsics are only compiled on 64-bit ARM, fixing a compile failure on 32-bit ARM. It alters which code is compiled, not what any compiled build does: on AArch64 and x86 the resulting binary is identical to before, and on 32-bit ARM the scalar fallback is functionally equivalent to the SIMD path (which previously failed to build at all). There is no runtime behaviour, reply, or data path for a scenario to exercise or compare.
